title: Incident with Pull Requests
summary: This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.

timeline.body: We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Pull Requests
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We’re investigating elevated timeouts when merging pull requests. Some users may be unable to merge pull requests successfully; timeouts are occurring at a higher rate than usual. We’re working to identify the cause and restore normal performance.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We’re continuing to investigate elevated pull request merge timeouts. Approximately 2–3% of merges are timing out, compared with a baseline near 0.2%. We’ll share another update as we learn more.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We’re continuing to investigate elevated pull request merge timeouts. Approximately 2–3% of merges are timing out, compared with a baseline near 0.2%. Mitigations so far have not restored normal performance, and our teams are continuing to investigate. We’ll share another update as we learn more.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We’re continuing to investigate elevated pull request merge timeouts. Approximately 3% of merges are timing out, compared with a baseline near 0.2%. Mitigations so far have not materially improved performance, and our teams are working to reduce load and restore normal service. We’ll share another update as we learn more.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We’re continuing to investigate elevated pull request merge timeouts. The latest reported rate is 4.75%, compared with a baseline near 0.2%, so some users may have difficulty merging pull requests. We’ll share another update as we learn more.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: Actions is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We’re seeing early signs of improvement in pull request merge times, but recovery is not yet confirmed. The last confirmed timeout rate was 2.5%, compared with a baseline near 0.2%, so some users may still have difficulty merging pull requests. We’ll share another update as we learn more.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We’re seeing early signs of improvement in pull request merge times & workflow start times, but recovery is not yet confirmed. Users may still have difficulty merging pull requests. We’re reducing load on affected systems and monitoring the impact. We’ll share another update as we learn more.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The degradation affecting Actions and Pull Requests has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
timeline.label: monitoring

timeline.body: We’ve mitigated the issue affecting pull request merges and Actions workflow start times by reducing load on affected systems. Pull Requests and Actions have recovered, and we’re continuing to monitor their performance.
timeline.label: monitoring

timeline.body: This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.
timeline.label: resolved
